title: Validate desktop notices and the demo runtime manifest
text: Add two strict schemas to the contracts package, both exported with inferred types. DesktopNoticeSchema is a union discriminated by kind. A connection notice has a state of connecting, connected or offline and a boolean reconnectAvailable. A history-gap notice has an after cursor (CursorSchema). A retry notice has a boolean available. An export notice has an artifactId (ArtifactIdSchema) and an outcome of saved, cancelled or failed. Unknown fields, such as a path on an export notice, and wrong types are refused. RuntimeManifestSchema describes the pinned demo runtime without accepting executable paths: version is the literal 1, mode is the literal demo, and node holds the literal version 24.22.0, a platform of darwin or linux, an arch of arm64 or x64 and a sha256 hash. Any extra field on the manifest or on node, such as an entry or a path, is refused, as are other versions, modes, platforms, architectures and malformed hashes.

checks.name: contracts
args: --test-name-pattern=process boundaries reject unknown fields and invalid command identity

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout, and the checks ran with a minimal environment and a temporary home.
